priority: Definitions and controlling uncertainty first; cost only breaks ties
reference_crosscheck_rule: Both pointwise reported uncertainties must be available; compare absolute difference with their sum, not with the physical 0.001 target
missing_uncertainty: REFERENCE_SIDE_UNRESOLVED; no inferred uncertainty from printed digits, another R, basis contribution, or a primary author's general precision description
downstream_gate: D requires reference-side closure; E requires D; F requires E; G requires A through F. No numerical downstream calculation on an unclosed prerequisite
observations_before_seal: Primary PDFs were acquired and relevant pages visually reviewed before this audit seal. This is a source/definition audit, not a blinded new energy run
source_transcription: Manual decimal transcription from primary PDF page images; separately check extracted text. Do not generate the manual value from the old CSV
same_quantity_not_same_trial_space: Full finite-basis singlet minimum versus reference 1Sigma_g+ BO ground state; finite-basis limitation and observed state's spatial irrep remain separate questions
